Focused searches located historical Taiwan-specific reporting and newer regional or geographically unspecified claims, but no reliable current source establishing MyCard's Taiwan-only ranking and 60% share with a defined denominator and measurement basis.
The historical 60% figures are secondary reporting and do not disclose how market share was calculated.
The 2025 official 60% figure covers Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macau together and must not be substituted for Taiwan-only share.
The issuer's company-level ranking and its descriptions of e-PLAY do not establish a MyCard-specific ranking.
The 2026 report's near-50% figure lacks geographic scope and a measurement basis.
